versions.content: Uniqueness of shortNames of PortInterfaces within a software component The shortNames of PortInterfaces shall be unique within a software component for each set of PPortPrototypes or RPortPrototypes if the software component is delivered as object code or supports multiple instantiation, or if the indirectAPI attribute is set to ’true’ for at least one require or provide port. This is required to generate distinguishable Port Data Structure data types.
